thread:
irene: Hi team — Customer NovaRetail (acct: 99821) reports their daily CSV export for 2025-11-19 is missing rows between 13:00-15:00 UTC. Dashboard shows requests in that window and invoice reflects tokens, but CSV has a hole. S3 path they gave: s3://customer-exports/nova/2025-11-19/usage.csv :thinking_face:
ajay: thanks Irene. Do we have invoice id / customer-facing amount discrepancy? That will determine urgency. Also need raw export manifest and shard id if available.
irene: Invoice ID  INV-2025-99821-11, customer says ~1.2M tokens billed. CSV only contains 02:00-12:59 and 15:00-23:59 rows. They counted ~45k tokens missing from CSV slices but invoice includes them.
natalie: pinging data-eng — can you share export pipeline trace? Which export worker handled shard for that account on 2025-11-19? Also paste the manifest if possible.
export-bot: export-job: shard=14 job_id=exp-20251119-14 status=completed manifest=s3://manifests/exp-20251119-14.json size=0 bytes (note: empty manifest) :rotating_light:
zhou: I pulled the logs for the exporter cluster. There is a heartbeat gap on node exporter-03 from 2025-11-19T13:02:21Z to 2025-11-19T13:46:03Z. kubernetes shows a kubelet restart at 13:05 and job re-queued at 13:45. Worker processed later range but manifest size indicates commit step may have skipped pre-committed pages.
natalie: Suspect two issues: 1) the per-shard flusher didn't write the partial CSV for that interval due to a transient fsync failure on exporter-03; 2) the post-aggregation commit step (manifest writer) crashed before listing objects, leaving manifest empty. Found error in logs:
```
2025-11-19T13:05:10Z exporter-03 ERROR write_chunk shard=14 err=fsync failed: I/O error
2025-11-19T13:05:11Z exporter-03 FATAL commit_manifest shard=14 err=panic: nil pointer
```
natalie: Repro steps (local):
1) run export microservice with network fault injection: `go test -run TestExportWithFSyncFailure`
2) inject fsync error on chunk boundary
3) observe commit step aborts and manifest remains empty
(added test to repo: export/repro/fsync-failure_test.go)
ajay: Ok. Customer impact: CSV missing, but billing pipeline uses raw ledger + aggregation (separate path) so invoice still accurate. We should confirm ledger rows exist for that acct in 13:00-15:00.
zhou: Checked ledger: raw events exist for acct 99821 between 13:10 and 14:55, identical token counts reported on analytics side. So billing is correct; export is incomplete.
irene: Customer wants a corrected CSV and timeline. Proposed customer-facing response: "We found an exporter node crash that caused a gap in the generated CSV; we've scheduled a re-run and will deliver a corrected CSV within 6 hours. No change to billing; you're not charged twice." Thoughts?
ajay: Agree. Offer provisional credit if they prefer immediate reconciliation? Probably unnecessary since billing matches, but offer expedited file and apology. Also note for contracts team.
natalie: Plan:
- Data-eng: re-run export for 2025-11-19 shard=14 with fail-safes (force commit, verify manifest size) — target +2h
- Eng-runtime: patch exporter to tolerate fsync failures (backoff + retry) — hotfix PR queued
- SRE (zhou): mark exporter-03 for deeper disk health investigation and replace if flakey
- Support (irene): send customer ETA and a temporary CSV when re-run completes

zhou: Quick commands I ran:
```
# list manifest
aws s3 ls s3://manifests/exp-20251119-14.json
# tail logs
kubectl -n exports logs exporter-03 -c exporter --since=4h | grep "fsync failed"
```
irene: I'll reply to the customer now; copying recommended language. Also confirming they'd like the corrected CSV and whether they want a direct S3 link or email attachment.
export-bot: re-run-request accepted: job=reexport-20251119-14 queued by irene
natalie: After re-run completes, I'll run a binary diff between ledger-backed aggregator and CSV and post results. If row counts match ledger tokens, we can close.
ajay: Action: add an issue to billing-runbook noting export-only gaps don't imply invoice divergence; link to incident once we have postmortem.
irene: Thanks all — sending customer ETA (6h) and will update thread when CSV delivered. :thumbsup: "
